P. 56 and UCC Article 2 as adopted in Texas. Contractual risks identified: overbroad indemnification (Section 8.1), unenforceable non-compete (Section 12.1), and exclusion of consequential damages. Motion seeks partial summary judgment on liability for breach of software licensing agreement with damages calculation pending.

Contract analysis confirms high-risk provisions in the original agreement, particularly concerning indemnification and non-compete clauses, which we have addressed in our motion.
